messages:
Aisha (CS): Hey team — NovaCare sent an updated vendor risk assessment and DPA follow-up.
Can someone pick this up? Link: https://files.redwoodinternal/vra/novacare_2026.pdf :eyes:

Priya (Onboarding): I can take lead on the questionnaire. I'll start a column in the onboarding tracker and ping the account team.

Ben (Security): Quick Qs: do we have NovaCare's SOC 2 report (Type II) or an AICPA letter? Also need KMS details and whether they support customer-managed keys.

Tom (Legal): If they only have SOC 2 Type I we should request Type II or an interim bridge letter. Also confirm DPA signature status — contract team owns that.

questionnaire-bot: Received nova-care_vra_2026.pdf. Extracted fields: encryption_at_rest: unknown, soc2_type: unknown, dpa_signed: no, pci_scope: no

Aisha (CS): Ben/Tom — can you both review the extracted fields? Priya will cross-reference with the onboarding checklist.

Ben (Security): I'll check their attestation and KMS notes, ETA 9am PT tomorrow. If they don't support CMKs we may flag for restricted data use.

Tom (Legal): I'll ask contracts to check DPA status and push for countersign. ETA EOD today.

Priya (Onboarding): Added tasks:
- Verify SOC2 Type II (owner: Ben)
- Confirm DPA countersign (owner: Tom)
- Update onboarding tracker + risk flag (owner: Priya)
Due: 2026-04-02

Aisha (CS): Also renewing in ~6 weeks. Mark as potential renewal risk until DPA/SOC2 cleared. Added to renewal-risk dashboard. :thumbsup:

Ben (Security): If we need an interim mitigation, recommend removing PHI scope and enabling strict logging. Will prepare suggested controls.

Tom (Legal): Noted. Tagging @contracts for countersign.

Aisha (CS): Thanks — will loop in account team and update NovaCare with expected timelines.

Priya (Onboarding): FYI — I attached the questionnaire extraction snippet below for quick ref:
```
status: pending
required_docs: [SOC2_Type_II, Signed_DPA]
kms: unknown
notes: vendor provided partial answers in Q3 2025
```

Aisha (CS): Ping me once you have any change, I'll post a short note to the customer success board.

questionnaire-bot: Thread closed by inactivity after 48h (reminder set for 2026-03-30).
